name: kometa
description: Kometa(https://github.com/Kometa-Team/Kometa) is a powerful tool designed to give you complete control over your media libraries. With Kometa, you can take your customization to the next level, with granular control over metadata, collections, overlays, and much more.

variables.name: KOMETA_CONFIG
variables.description: Specify a custom config file to use.

variables.name: KOMETA_TIMES
variables.description: Comma-separated list of times to update each day. Format: `HH:MM`.

variables.name: KOMETA_RUN
variables.description: Set to `True` to run without the scheduler.

variables.name: KOMETA_TESTS
variables.description: Set to `True` to run in debug mode with only collections that have `test: true`.

variables.name: KOMETA_NO_MISSING
variables.description: Set to `True` to run without any of the missing movie/show functions.
